findings.reader: A well-executed bounded news article: it answers legal status first, keeps each proposal's speaker, vehicle, coverage and trigger together, defines terms in context, calibrates certainty (including the missing bill number), and lands a genuinely transferable reading tool. No failure families present; comprehension and transfer both verified.
findings.facts: Factually sound: every material claim traces to the correct source with attribution and limits intact, including the deliberately preserved conditionals and the disclosed absence of a bill number. The only qualification is a slight generalization of the sponsors' superintelligence definition ('defeat important forms of human control' for 'overthrow human governments'), which does not mislead. Dates, sequencing and uncertainty handling all pass.
